about: The Android store screenshots' scenes, for tools/store_shots.py android: each is a cold start of the debug build (am start -S -W) with launch extras, steps, then a screencap to <raw>/<target rawDir>/<name>.png, which make_art.py shots frames with the caption of the same name in brand/shots.json. The extras are DebugLaunch.kt's (android/app/src/debug/): the iOS launch arguments' names, ios/EpicAudioGames/Debug/DebugLaunch.swift. Steps: {wait: regex, timeout: s} waits for an EpicShots log line of the app's new process that matches (re.search), {sleep: s}, {tap: test tag} (uiautomator; TalkBack off), {swipe: [x1, y1, x2, y2] as shares of the screen, ms}, {key: KEYCODE_...}; the short form is wait + timeout + after (a sleep). fontScale is the system font scale for the scene (put back afterwards). Check the extras, their types and the log lines against DebugLaunch.kt before a run: py -3.13 tools/store_shots.py list prints every command.

extras.about: types: how each extra goes to am (bool --ez, string --es, int --ei, float --ef); numbers go as text unless a type says otherwise. always: given to every scene (a scene's null takes one away). EpicReset clears the saves and settings (store_shots.py puts the app's own back afterwards), EpicAnalytics off for every automated run.

demo.about: SystemUI demo mode during the run: the clock (hhmm), the battery (percent, not charging), Wi-Fi bars (0-4), no mobile signal, notifications hidden.

phone.about: A 16:9 phone, Play's 1080x1920 (the emulator's own density).

tablet10.about: A 10-inch tablet: 800x1280 dp. Play takes 8 screenshots for 10-inch tablets: 4 upright (04, 05, 07, 08) and 4 turned (tablet10-land: 01, 02, 03, 06) share its folder.

tablet10-land.about: The 10-inch tablet turned: 1280x800 dp, expanded width (the two-pane game, Help's list and topic side by side). Turned the other way (3, not 1): the phone emulator's camera cutout then sits on the right, beyond the transcript, instead of pushing the rail's content away from it on the left (a strip and a stray edge line no real tablet shows).

wear.about: A Wear OS watch, the second adb device (--wear SERIAL), with the Wear app's debug build (android/wear) installed: it shows a game's state by itself, worded as the phone sends it (EpicWatchDemo, android/wear/src/debug/.../WatchDemo.kt), so no phone or pairing is needed. Its screen as it is (square, unframed). Not run yet: there was no Wear OS emulator when this was set up.
